feed.title: tashan — what changed
feed.subtitle: Advisories, install scripts, permission changes and abandonment across the MCP corpus — measured daily from public evidence.

entry.title: Voila Groceries — voila-mcp now reaches database
entry.summary: Its declared dependencies reach further into your machine than they did before. Confirm the new reach is something this tool should have.

entry.title: Skim402 — skim402 now runs a script when it installs
entry.summary: Install-time code executes on your machine before you have used the tool once, and it did not do this before. Read the command on the dossier — it is free — before your next install or CI run.

entry.title: Vanta · @vantasdk — the author of @vantasdk/vanta-mcp-server has declared it unmaintained
entry.summary: Nobody is going to fix the next problem with this, including a security one. Plan a replacement. The dossier links what else does this work.

entry.title: Dod Guard — dod-guard was marked deprecated on npm
entry.summary: The publisher is telling installers to stop using it. Move to the successor named in the deprecation notice.

entry.title: Dod Guard — dod-guard now reads as abandoned, was active
entry.summary: Upkeep signals stopped, under enough issue pressure that it is not merely finished. Check whether an alternative is better maintained before you depend on it further.
